body:
RULED, for this unit only, under the same caps: 76 calls, 12000 s, F8 and the phase caps. No waiver, reset or extra round.

1. Review: your route (b) stands. The one R1 was spent on the superseded FILE tip 941277f8, and its receipt is kept. The whole URL, 60 s and busy delta ships UNREVIEWED and is named so in the PASS; the XO's signing audit is its only review. Codex's demonstrated HIGH is superseded only where it conflicts with the before-lock contract. The HTTP-wait part needs a current route trace and a test that measures the gap between the presence answer and the start of playback.

2. Setup S7 of 6 is a named THIS-UNIT qualification. The extra call comes out of the global 76; no phase cap rises.

3. Whole clocks for BOOT, intake and Reads 31 and 34-36 are UNKNOWN. As with 7374: no call predates the mint order (19:30:50), and the report was admitted at 20:11:44. Calls 1-50 are charged that span, 2454 s, so 9546 s and 26 calls remain. From the next call, each call's first command stamps the ledger.

4. R1 lanes: the hand-up shows, by exact unit or pid, that none remains. It reports measured concurrency; the rest is UNKNOWN.

5. The tip also carries the busy amendment and its four tests. If that will not fit, propose before overrunning.

I am asking the Desk whether to re-check busy after the lock. Until it answers, build to the contract as written.
